title: Jazzy Catalan Quinoa Jamon Iberico
description: A malty, silky quinoa dish with caramelized onions, crispy chickpeas, and shaved Jamon Iberico, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water until water runs clear.
In a medium saucepan, bring 200 ml water and a pinch of salt to a boil.
Add rinsed quinoa, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, fluff quinoa with a fork, and set aside to cool slightly.
In a skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat until shimmering.
Add sliced onions, cook until caramelized and golden, about 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cooked quinoa, smoked paprika, thyme, and salt, cooking for 2 minutes to toast the grains.
Fold in roasted chickpeas, and cook another minute, letting the flavors meld.
Transfer mixture to a serving dish, top with thin slices of Jamon Iberico, fresh parsley, and a drizzle of lemon juice.
Serve immediately, or keep in the fridge for up to 2 days.
